{{Top|leg}}
The '''Elomin Council''' was the ruling body of the [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==History==
During the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Elomin Council placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on the Elomin [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Laerron Woern]], as they considered him to be a disgrace to their species.
